logical_retention_estimate.interpretation: These are payload/capacity sums for one representative per exact digest/profile key. They are lower-bound accounting figures for a hypothetical bounded cache, not a measured allocator or RSS bound. Borrowed projections require a separately retained source owner only if the source package does not already keep it alive.
